title: Purple Lady seen on first DMT trip

tellings.quote: >> So but you know Purple Lady I saw when I did DMT the first time

plain: Kurt Metzger, a guest on an episode about Jeffrey Epstein and aliens, says that the first time he took DMT, a powerful psychedelic drug, he saw a figure he calls the Purple Lady. He mentions it to Michels in passing as his own experience, without saying here what she looked like or did. To him it suggests the drug shows real beings rather than just hallucinations.
